column1: # WP-CI-SERVICE-TESTS-03 FIX1 (CT decision): the ONLY skips the service-tests job accepts. One line per (suite, code):
# suite<TAB>CODE<TAB>max<TAB>reason. A skip passes only when its TRX reason STARTS with the code and the job's suite matches;
# more than max skips with one code is red (FIX2: max = the tests carrying the code, measured at 6148288a8: one each).
# Anything else — no reason, an unknown code, a code listed for another suite (UNIX_ONLY is listed nowhere: on Ubuntu
# it must not happen) — is red. Adding a line is a Control Tower decision; the reason column says why the test cannot
# be true on that runner. Source of the codes: BL-570 FIX4 (6148288a8), UnixConditionalFacts.cs.
